demonstrated_cause_and_repair.cause: The full guest SSH runner inherits umask 0002. Both preserved failed roots have an owner-only run/hub/packs tree but a group-writable run/hub/packs/.staging directory (0775). The candidate pack writer calls ensure_private_staging_directory before it can chmod the directory; that function rejects mode bits 0022, exactly after the first vehicle's five materialised drives and one charge but before the first pack. The three successful standalone seed diagnostics explicitly set umask 0077. Read-only kernel/cgroup evidence has zero OOM kills and the guest had 6,653,857,792 bytes free, so resource exhaustion is excluded from this failure.
demonstrated_cause_and_repair.repair: The runner now invokes every observed seed child with subprocess umask=0o077, preserving Hub's fail-closed rejection of preexisting unsafe staging paths rather than weakening it. A real child test first forced parent umask 0002 and required a child-visible 0077; it failed before this repair (child exit 1) and the focused suite then passed 25 tests, including the controlled exit/signal/timeout/redaction cases.
